meta.title: हे कसे कार्य करते
meta.description: प्रश्नाचे उत्तरात कसे रूपांतर होते, स्रोत लक्षात ठेवण्याऐवजी शोधून का काढले जातात आणि सिस्टीम केव्हा उत्तर देण्यास नकार देते.

heading: एका प्रश्नाचे संदर्भासह उत्तरात कसे रूपांतर होते
standfirst: एखादा प्रश्न स्रोतांसह उत्तर कसे बनतो, आणि अंदाज लावण्याऐवजी प्रणाली उत्तर देण्यास केव्हा नकार देते.

status.heading: प्रत्यक्षात काय तयार केले आहे
status.body: प्रत्येक उत्तर पडताळलेल्या अधिकृत स्रोतांतून तयार होते — स्रोत पानावर सूचीबद्ध कायदे, नियम, मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे आणि सरकारी पोर्टल — आणि प्रत्येक दावा त्याच्या स्रोताशी जोडलेला असतो.

pipeline.heading: प्रश्नाचे काय होते
pipeline.standfirst: तेरा टप्पे. ते काय करते हे पाहण्यासाठी एक निवडा.

detect.name: भाषा ओळख
detect.does: (भाषा ओळख) Works out which of the six supported languages the question is in, with a confidence score.
detect.outputs: (भाषा ओळख) A language code and a confidence, both shown in the interface so the reader can correct them.
detect.fails: (भाषा ओळख) A wrong guess is visible and correctable rather than silent. Below a confidence floor it asks instead of guessing.

understand.name: प्रश्न समज
understand.does: (प्रश्न समज) Extracts what is being asked: intent, which rights are in play, which regulatory areas, hints about the product class, and named entities such as herbs, dosage forms and destination markets.
understand.outputs: (प्रश्न समज) A structured query, plus a decision on whether the question can be answered at all without more facts.
understand.fails: (प्रश्न समज) An ambiguous question routes to a clarifying question rather than to a confident answer about the wrong thing.

clarify.name: स्पष्टीकरण
clarify.does: (स्पष्टीकरण) Where the answer depends on what the product is regulatorily and that is not yet known, asks the single most decisive question rather than answering for every possibility.
clarify.outputs: (स्पष्टीकरण) Either a product class, or an explicit statement that the answer is conditional on it.
clarify.fails: (स्पष्टीकरण) If the reader declines to answer, the system says which way the answer would turn rather than picking one.

route.name: अधिकारक्षेत्र विभाजन
route.does: (अधिकारक्षेत्र विभाजन) Selects the namespace to search. India and International are separate indexes, and a single retrieval call reads one of them.
route.outputs: (अधिकारक्षेत्र विभाजन) A namespace, or two retrievals for a cross-border question.
route.fails: (अधिकारक्षेत्र विभाजन) There is no fallback that merges the two. A question that cannot be routed is asked which jurisdiction it means.

retrieve.name: माहिती शोध
retrieve.does: (माहिती शोध) Hybrid search over the selected namespace: keyword matching and dense vectors, fused. Metadata filters are applied before scoring — jurisdiction, effective date window, document type, product class and topic — so superseded text is never a candidate.
retrieve.outputs: (माहिती शोध) A candidate set of passages with their scores and metadata.
retrieve.fails: (माहिती शोध) Below a retrieval floor there is nothing to answer from, and the pipeline goes to abstention rather than to generation.

rerank.name: पुन्हा क्रमवारी
rerank.does: (पुन्हा क्रमवारी) A cross-encoder reads each candidate against the question and reorders them, cutting a broad candidate set down to the few that actually bear on it.
rerank.outputs: (पुन्हा क्रमवारी) A short ranked list, carrying both the retrieval score and the rerank score.
rerank.fails: (पुन्हा क्रमवारी) If nothing clears the rerank threshold, that is itself a signal, and confidence drops or the system abstains.

context.name: संदर्भ जुळणी
context.does: (संदर्भ जुळणी) Packs the chosen passages with their metadata headers — title, section path, version, effective date — so the model can attribute what it uses. The token budget is enforced with document diversity, so the window is never filled from a single document.
context.outputs: (संदर्भ जुळणी) A context block where every passage is addressable by id.
context.fails: (संदर्भ जुळणी) If diversity cannot be met, the answer is marked as resting on a single source, which caps its confidence.

generate.name: उत्तर निर्मिती
generate.does: (उत्तर निर्मिती) Answers from the provided passages and nothing else, under a prompt that forbids stating anything not present in them. Output is schema-constrained: the four blocks, plus a machine-readable map from each claim to the passages supporting it.
generate.outputs: (उत्तर निर्मिती) Structured blocks and a claim-to-passage map, never prose to be parsed afterwards.
generate.fails: (उत्तर निर्मिती) If the passages do not support an answer, the model is required to return an abstention object rather than its best guess.

map.name: संदर्भ मॅपिंग
map.does: (संदर्भ मॅपिंग) Checks every passage id the model returned against the passages actually supplied. Any claim whose citation does not verify is dropped.
map.outputs: (संदर्भ मॅपिंग) An answer where every marker resolves to a real retrieved passage.
map.fails: (संदर्भ मॅपिंग) If too many claims drop, the answer is downgraded or abstains. An uncited answer is never shown in place of a cited one.

confidence.name: विश्वास मूल्यांकन
confidence.does: (विश्वास मूल्यांकन) Computes high, moderate, low or abstain from the retrieval result — how many passages cleared the threshold, how many distinct documents they came from, whether they contradict each other, and whether they are all within their effective window.
confidence.outputs: (विश्वास मूल्यांकन) A level and a one-sentence reason, both shown.
confidence.fails: (विश्वास मूल्यांकन) Records never raise or lower it. Confidence is a property of the sources, not of how the answer reads.

abstain.name: नकार तपासणी
abstain.does: (नकार तपासणी) The last gate before an answer is shown. Decides whether the question was out of scope, whether the sources conflict, whether they are out of date, or whether nothing relevant was found.
abstain.outputs: (नकार तपासणी) Either an answer, or one of the abstention states below with what the reader is offered next.
abstain.fails: (नकार तपासणी) This is the stage that is allowed to fail loudly. Abstaining is a correct outcome, not an error.

translate.name: भाषांतर
translate.does: (भाषांतर) Translates the answer into the reader's language, behind an interface so the implementation can be swapped — including for national language infrastructure.
translate.outputs: (भाषांतर) A translated answer with untranslated citation metadata.
translate.fails: (भाषांतर) Source passages are never translated. A translated citation is no longer a citation, and a reader checking a source needs the words as published.

render.name: उत्तर सादरीकरण
render.does: (उत्तर सादरीकरण) Renders the four blocks with claim-level markers, the confidence and its reason, and the source cards behind them. Sentences resting on no passage are marked as general explanation.
render.outputs: What you see on the workspace.
render.fails: (उत्तर सादरीकरण) If citation mapping produced nothing to show, this surface renders an abstention rather than an unsourced answer.

retrieval.heading: स्रोत लक्षात ठेवण्याऐवजी शोधून का काढले जातात
retrieval.body1: A language model answering a legal question from training data answers from memory: undated, unattributed, and confidently wrong on anything amended since it was trained. It cannot tell you where it got something, because it does not know.
retrieval.body2: Retrieval constrains the answer to a curated, version-tracked set of published documents. Each claim points at the passage behind it, and every answer carries the date of the sources it used.
retrieval.body3: It reduces hallucination and localises it. It does not eliminate it: a model can still misread a passage, or state something the passage does not quite say. So every claim is checkable against the passage it names, sentences resting on nothing are marked, and the system abstains rather than produce something plausible.

abstention.heading: उत्तर देण्यास नकार देणे हे एक वैशिष्ट्य आहे
abstention.standfirst: Most of the work in a product like this is in knowing when not to answer. These are the states, with what each one offers the reader next. The logic behind them is designed and not yet built; what you see here is the surface it will use.

nothing.title: Nothing relevant found
nothing.body: I couldn't find anything in these sources that answers this reliably.
nothing.offers: Rephrase, narrow the jurisdiction, name the product type, see what's covered, or send the question to a human with the context already filled in.

scope.title: Outside what this covers
scope.body: Outside what I can answer. I cover intellectual property and regulatory requirements for Ayurvedic products — not clinical advice, legal opinions, or predictions about whether an application will succeed.
scope.offers: A plain statement of what it can do instead, and the escalation route.

conflict.title: The sources disagree
conflict.body: Two passages point different ways, and the answer depends on which governs.
conflict.offers: Both passages, with their dates and their documents, so the reader can see the disagreement rather than being handed one side of it.

stale.title: The sources may be out of date
stale.body: What was found sits outside its effective window, or predates an amendment the corpus knows about.
stale.offers: The passage with its date shown, and a plain statement that the position may have changed.

facts.title: It depends on facts you have not given
facts.body: The answer turns on something only you know — usually what the product is regulatorily.
facts.offers: The single most decisive question, rather than a list of every possibility.

jurisdictions.heading: दोन नेमस्पेस, कधीही एकत्र नाहीत
jurisdictions.body: India and International are separate indexes. A retrieval call reads one; a cross-border question runs two and produces two answers rather than one blended paragraph. An answer mixing the Indian position with an export market's is wrong in a way that reads as right, and a reader could not tell which half applied to them.
jurisdictions.note: These two answers were produced separately and are shown side by side. Nothing in the product merges them, and no interface anywhere presents a single answer covering both.

architecture.heading: हे कसे जोडले गेले आहे
architecture.standfirst: Layers, and what state each part is in. The retriever's metadata filters are listed because they are what makes superseded text unreachable rather than merely deprioritised.
architecture.filters: Jurisdiction · product class · IP right · regulatory area · effective date window · document type · language
architecture.notScheduledBody: A knowledge graph over entities and provisions, agentic orchestration across several sources, connectors to subscription databases. Directions, not commitments. None is being built.

evaluation.heading: हे कसे मोजले जाते
evaluation.standfirst: These are the axes it will be scored on. Two of them have a target of one hundred per cent, because a single failure on either is the kind that destroys trust in everything else.
evaluation.notRunBody: There is no corpus to retrieve from and no pipeline to score, so there are no numbers on this page. When the harness runs it will write a summary that this page reads, and whatever it says will appear here — including the bad numbers. A page of metric definitions with no results is less impressive than a table of figures, and considerably more honest.

answerAccuracy.name: उत्तर अचूकता
answerAccuracy.what: Whether the answer is right, judged against a reference answer and spot-checked by a person.
answerAccuracy.target: as high as the sources allow

citationCorrectness.name: संदर्भ अचूकता
citationCorrectness.what: Whether the passage a claim cites actually supports that claim.

citationValidity.name: संदर्भ वैधता
citationValidity.what: (संदर्भ वैधता) Whether every citation resolves to a real, current passage.

abstentionPrecision.name: नकार अचूकता
abstentionPrecision.what: (नकार अचूकता) When it declines, whether it was right to.

abstentionRecall.name: नकार पुनर्प्राप्ती
abstentionRecall.what: (नकार पुनर्प्राप्ती) Whether it answers the questions it should answer, rather than declining defensively.

jurisdictionPurity.name: अधिकारक्षेत्र शुद्धता
jurisdictionPurity.what: (अधिकारक्षेत्र शुद्धता) Whether any answer mixes the Indian position with another jurisdiction's.

authorityPurity.name: प्राधिकरण शुद्धता
authorityPurity.what: (प्राधिकरण शुद्धता) Whether a filed or granted record ever appeared as a citation.

classificationAccuracy.name: वर्गीकरण अचूकता
classificationAccuracy.what: (वर्गीकरण अचूकता) Whether the product class the flow reaches is the right one.

multilingualQuality.name: बहुभाषिक गुणवत्ता
multilingualQuality.what: Whether an answer in Telugu is as good as the same answer in English, judged by a speaker.

latency.name: विलंब
latency.what: How long an answer takes, at the median and at the tail.

citationGroundedness.name: संदर्भ आधार
citationGroundedness.what: (संदर्भ आधार) Whether every citation points at a passage that was actually retrieved for that question. Narrower than citation correctness, and unlike it, checkable by a machine.

citationCoverage.name: संदर्भ कव्हरेज
citationCoverage.what: चाचणी प्रश्नाला अपेक्षित असलेल्या किमान एका दस्तऐवजाचा उत्तर संदर्भ देते का.
citationCoverage.target: as high as the corpus allows

abstentionReason.name: नकाराचे कारण
abstentionReason.what: (नकाराचे कारण) When it declines, whether it declines for the right one of the five reasons rather than merely declining.

forbiddenClaims.name: निषिद्ध दावे
forbiddenClaims.what: (निषिद्ध दावे) Whether answers avoid the phrases each case forbids — novelty conclusions, outcome predictions, dosage.

languageDetection.name: भाषा ओळख
languageDetection.what: (भाषा ओळख) Whether the script a question is written in is identified. Devanagari cannot separate Hindi from Marathi, so either counts for either and the interface reports the ambiguity.

recordsOffered.name: सादर केलेले रेकॉर्ड
recordsOffered.what: (सादर केलेले रेकॉर्ड) Whether filed or granted records appear beside an answer when the question is about the kind of thing that gets filed.

recordsDoNotRescue.name: रेकॉर्ड बचाव करत नाहीत
recordsDoNotRescue.what: (रेकॉर्ड बचाव करत नाहीत) Where a record exists and the sources do not support an answer, whether the system still declines.

errors.name: त्रुटी
errors.what: (त्रुटी) Cases that raised rather than answering or declining.
